integrity: All algebraic formulas follow from an explicit central-intersection dichotomy and linear Goursat counting. A reproducible checker independently enumerated RREF subspaces in eight finite instances. Independent review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts finite-field, F_q-linear nonunital associative subalgebras of the strict (1,r,1)-block radical only; not Lie subalgebras, integral suborders, full parabolic algebras, or isomorphism classes. Earlier literature comparison is a best-knowledge assessment, not a publication-priority certificate.
title: Exact associative-subalgebra spectra in three-block nilpotent radicals
